title: ConsentMessage
description: The host's record that a person decided an escalation. Only a host sends it, never an agent. It names the exact terms_hash the person saw, how the host knows it was the owner (assurance), and when. The counterparty's copy omits reasons. A signed consent (envelope sig) is the verifiable human-consent record.

assurance.description: session: the owner approved in a signed-in host session. passkey: the owner's passkey signed a challenge derived from terms_hash. email_link: a one-time link sent to the owner. client_prompt: an MCP client asked the person (the host cannot tell a person from an auto-approving client, so it is the weakest).
